text: Every zylo video now has a home on the web. It's called zylo dot video. In the next three minutes, I'll show you everything you can do there.
Open the site and you land on our slogan, read word by word, just like the captions in our Shorts. One fact a day that changes how you see the world.

Right below it, you see the whole channel at a glance. How many videos there are, when the latest one came out, and how many views they have together. On the right, a stack of phones shows the newest videos. Tap the front one, and it starts playing.

Scroll down and you reach the archive. This is every single zylo video, more than eighty of them, and the list keeps itself up to date. When a new video goes up on YouTube, it appears here on its own, usually within fifteen minutes.

Each card shows the cover, the title, the date, and the number of views. The newest video wears a yellow new tag, and the longer full stories are marked, so you always know what you're about to watch.
Looking for something specific? Pick a rubric. Weird science and the body, psychology, money and tech, or history and space.
Or just search. Type zombie, and you get every zombie episode in a second. You can sort by newest, oldest, or most viewed, and load more whenever you reach the end.
Tap any video, and it plays right there on the page, in a pop up player. If you'd rather watch on YouTube, one button takes you there.

Now my favorite part. Got an idea for a video? Write it in the suggest form, pick a rubric, and if you like, leave your name and email. We read every idea, and the best ones become new videos. If yours makes it, you'll hear from us.

Curious about something right now? Ask zylo. Type any question about science, the brain, money, history, or space, or tap one of the examples. You get a short answer in a few sentences, and if we made a video about it, a link to watch it.
Still have questions? The FAQ covers how often we post, how we check every fact, and how the videos are made.
The whole site works just as well on your phone, with videos in two columns and big buttons. And it follows your device, with a dark theme for the night and a light one for the day.
So that's zylo dot video. Watch every video, suggest the next one, and ask anything you want. And if you don't want to miss a single fact, hit subscribe. See you there.
